searchText: <pjickling> test Looking at the various configs the needed data is at multiple levels. So simply hashing a shared config won't work. We can either custom specify an RLP or hash a canonical YAML (no standards) or JSON (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785) sounds like we need to add event topics to this as well as contract addresses Will the topics change? The current issue sounds more like a spec oversight. the event must not change, such deposit contract wouldn't be supported then Yeah for this we could have easily added a test, it was just that we didn’t know it had this special functionality so even if the contract address/impl changes, the event hash wont? Correct. Hash is just a hash of the abi Related question: should the config include indication of activated eips that don't have config? Or do we include an omnibus "fork":"<name>" member? a fork needs at the very least a forkpoint, but i wouldn't include EIPs that don't require configs. (loosely held) hmmm. on second thought, listing each EIP regardless is useful for other networks. 🤔 feature flags to activate the eip would be down from that, but it's getting client specific
